verdict.rationale: Docs confirm exposed web services via web proxy for Pods (runpod-docs-14, runpod-docs-45) and multi-node high-performance networking via Instant Clusters for distributed workloads (runpod-docs-4, runpod-docs-17, runpod-docs-37), plus shared network volumes across machines (runpod-docs-40, runpod-docs-54). However, private networking is only documented in the context of Instant Clusters (multi-node training) rather than general arbitrary-instance-to-instance private networking, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of port exposure or inter-pod networking reliability. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of port-forwarding/web-proxy reliability, and clearer docs on general (non-cluster) private networking between arbitrary Pods.
